title: Canonical NDC v2 Profile 1 versioned per-event-type payload schema registry — version 1
description: Each event type declares an explicit schema identity, schema version and registered digest. A single manifest-wide scalar payload_schema_version and a silent positional array are both rejected. An event type with no registered entry fails closed. The same typed entry shape is used by schema_versions.payload_schemas in the manifest.

digest_sha256.description: Registered digest of the exact bytes of that event type's payload schema.

PayloadSchemaEntry.description: Explicit identity plus version plus registered digest. Entries are keyed by event_type value, not by array position.

PayloadSchemaRegistry.description: Standalone registry document. event_type values must be unique; each digest must match the registered payload schema bytes (semantic constraint).

Payload.description: Strict abstract payload container used by the record envelope. Field names and scalar kinds for a given event type must match that event type's registered payload schema.
